meta.name: value-specification
meta.description: Translating organisational values and user expectations into system constraints.

copy.tagline: 将组织价值观转化为系统约束
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把抽象价值观落地为可执行的技术规范。
copy.tagline_en: Translate organizational values into system constraints
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn abstract values into actionable technical specs.

howto.what: 将抽象的组织价值观和用户期望转化为可测试的系统约束规则。当价值观冲突时，按安全、准确、帮助、尊重、品牌的层级解决冲突，并呈现选项供用户选择。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 基于特定价值观（如“要负责”“要公平”）来约束行为，或需要将抽象原则转化为具体规则时触发。

say.text: 帮我制定一条尊重用户自主权的规则。
安全性与帮助性冲突时怎么处理？
say.note: Claude 会依据价值观层级解释，安全性优先。

say.text: 为这个规则写一个测试用例。
say.note: Claude 会设计一个模糊请求并检查是否询问用户选择。

howto.what_en: Translates abstract organizational values and user expectations into concrete, testable system constraints. When values conflict, resolves them using a hierarchy: safety > accuracy > helpfulness > respect > brand alignment, and presents options to users.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to constrain behavior based on specific values (e.g., 'be responsible', 'be fair') or to turn abstract principles into actionable rules.

say_en.text: Create a rule for respecting user autonomy.
How to handle conflict between safety and helpfulness?
say_en.note: Claude explains using the value hierarchy: safety overrides helpfulness.

say_en.text: Write a test case for this rule.
say_en.note: Claude designs an ambiguous request and checks if it asks the user to choose.
